entities.summary: Al-Aman Mosque is located in Souk Ahras, Algeria, in the city center. It covers an area of 5,688 square meters and can accommodate 4,400 worshippers. It includes a library with 200 seats, a parking lot, and a Quranic school. Construction of this religious edifice with its striking aesthetic architecture began in early February 2011 with a program license of 885 million Algerian dinars, and was handed over in 2016.
